title: Sensor count message
description: Published every 5 s on venue/{venue_id}/sensor/{sensor_id}/count. Counts only: no positions or identities.

ts.description: Simulation time in seconds since run start

zone_id.description: Zone the sensor covers (from the venue file)

count.description: Noisy number of detected devices or tags

seq.description: Increases by 1 per message from this sensor; used to detect gaps and duplicates
